items.text: Chainalysis, whose tools law enforcement and crypto exchanges use to trace illicit money, says an attacker 'using offensive agentic techniques' got into its systems and exposed customers' names, emails, user IDs and role labels. No sign so far of passwords or investigation files reached.
Comcast filed notices cutting 912 jobs in Philadelphia, New Jersey and Washington state, effective Dec 31, as executives expand AI agents for customer service.
Palo Alto Networks confirms a suspected state-linked actor is using chained flaws, including the PHP ones, against a small number of customer firewalls. No customer named.
